decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer was launched only in 2018 and fits the firm's core marking and coding business, so results have not yet fallen clearly below aspiration, and a large established firm has the slack to carry it while results are still uncertain.

The numbering software module needs few resources, extends the firm's existing inline printing software portfolio and supports hardware sales, so there is no shortfall that would prompt problemistic search for other uses.

The coder for non-absorbent surfaces serves an established industrial application within the core product line, and one year on the market is too short to judge it against aspiration levels, so the firm's slack makes keeping it the boundedly rational choice.
